name: Agra–Lucknow Expressway

timeline.event: Inaugurated in November; air force fighter jets land on the expressway's airstrip

history: The Agra–Lucknow Expressway was built by UPEIDA to give Uttar Pradesh's capital, Lucknow, a fast link to Agra and onward to Delhi. Work started in 2014 and the road was ready in about two years, which was very fast for a project of this size. It was inaugurated in November 2016, when air force fighter jets landed on a special straight stretch of the road, and it fully opened to the public in 2017.
facts: At 302 km, it was India's longest expressway when it opened.
Built in about 23 months — one of the fastest expressway builds in India.
Has a 3.3 km airstrip stretch near Bangarmau in Unnao district, used by air force fighter jets for practice landings.
Meets the Yamuna Expressway at Agra, so you can drive from Greater Noida to Lucknow entirely on expressways.
The Bundelkhand Expressway joins it near Etawah.

sources.title: UPEIDA — Uttar Pradesh Expressways Industrial Development Authority
